text.text: Four notable open spaces: Central Park, the beach, the running track and the BBQ area. Illustrations by the Hulhumalé group.
text.label: Figures

text.text: Open space per person, 2026 and 2050 (worst case, projected). Source: HDC.

Hulhumalé has about 2.7 m² of public open space per person today (2026). The plan adds more, but the population grows faster: from 130,197 to about 349,094 by 2050. In the worst case, that leaves about 2.5 m² each, against a guide of 9 m² (Kuchelmeister, 1998).
